note: Officially Muskellunge Lake Campground (locally 'Musky Lake'), under tall pines on the southeast corner of Big Muskellunge Lake, next to Crystal Lake. The west row of sites (about 301-312 and 339-352) runs along the lakeshore. Boat landing with extra parking and direct access to the Heart of Vilas County paved bike trail; the swimming beach is at the nearby Crystal Lake picnic area. Back-in sites with gravel spurs. --Claude
